name: US equity stress
summary: VIX near 23.8 on 27 Nov, down 11% on the week; S&P 500 6.7% below its 52-week high
state: The VIX closed near 23.8 on 27 Nov, 11% lower on the week and well below its 20 Nov peak near 35.9, but 23% higher on the month (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 ended the shortened 27 Nov session near 7,297, 5.6% up on the week and 6.7% below its 52-week high of 7,819, inside the 5–15% Watch band. No circuit breaker has tripped.
for_you: Equity markets remain in a stress regime, though easing. Pension and investment values linked to US shares can swing more than usual while volatility stays above 20.
rubric_hit: VIX 23.8 ≥ 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 6.67% ≥ 5% Watch line
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
